records.notes: Editions compared (all opened as PDF from s7d2.scene7.com): DS50GS/1109 (2009, O&G GS, C10550199; Spanish DS50GS-ES/1109 C10574557 identical): 4600 kWe, 12 270 kJ/kWe-hr, 68 680 kg/hr, 510 C (950 F), PR printed '10:6:1', airflow 18.8 kg/s, turbine max 14,950 rpm, 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.2 m, 'Typical Weight: 38 945 kg (85,860 lb)'. DS50PG/0113 (2013, PG, C10550154; Spanish C10574550 identical): same performance, PR 10.6:1, airflow printed '41.4 kg/sec (18.8 lb/sec)' (units swapped), 'Package Height: 3.2 m (10' 5")', 'Package Weight: 38 900 kg (85,800 lb)' (no basis stated). BIL/512 (2012 product line brochure, C10550168): 4600 kWe, 29.3 %, 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.2 m, 38 945 kg. BPGPSG/116 (2016 PG selection guide, C10550166): 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.2 m, 'Dry Weight' 37 785 kg. Power Generation Product Handbook BPGPH/0525 (2025, CM20190218-53670-53247, newest Solar document opened): 4.6 MW, 12,270 kJ/kWe-hr, 29.3 %, 19.1 kg/s, 509 C (949 F), 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.2 m, 37,785 kg / 83,300 lb dry unenclosed. Turbomach handbook BPHBTBM/512 (2012, C10518078): T-6201, 4.60 MW, 12'266 kJ/kWh, 29.34 %, 19.08 kg/s, 509 C; Turbomach package incl. filter for outdoor installation 10.0 x 2.2 x 6.6 m, 45 t (different package, not Solar standard). Older 2011 O&G brochure (C10550151) gives 'APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS (unenclosed)' 9.8 x 2.4 x 2.8 m, 27 080 kg for the Centaur 50 generator set - inconsistent with all data sheets, not used. Taken: power, heat rate, exhaust flow and temperature from the data sheets DS50PG/0113 and DS50GS/1109 (identical; power, heat rate and flow also match BPGPH/0525); handbook 509 C recorded as alternative (1 K difference). pkg_kg changed 38,945 -> 37,785: 38,945 is the 2009 O&G sheet 'typical' value; the newest documents (BPGPSG/116 2016, BPGPH/0525 2025) give 37,785 kg with stated basis 'Dry weight, unenclosed height and weight'; 38,900 (DS50PG/0113) and 38,945 (DS50GS/1109) listed above - real package weight depends on generator type and options. eff_pct is the published 'Engine efficiency: 29.3% (measured at generator terminals)'; 3600/12270 = 29.34 confirms. exh_flow_kg_s = published 68 680 kg/hr / 3600 = 19.08 (also printed by Turbomach as 19.08 kg/s). out_rpm: only 'Max. Speed: 14,950 rpm' is published for the single-shaft turbine (gearbox input); the earlier note 'used listings give NGP 14,944 (50 Hz)/14,951 (60 Hz)' came from third-party dealer listings that were not opened (hosts not allowed) and is dropped. The current solarturbines.com GS pages (power-generation-packages/centaur-50, oil-and-gas-power-generation-packages/centaur-50 and the HTML data-sheet pages under solutions/case-studies) returned HTTP 403 (Akamai) on two attempts 30 s apart, and WebFetch could not resolve the host; per search-index text only (not opened, not used as source) they show 4600 kWe, 12,270 kJ/kW-hr, 68,680 kg/hr, 510 C, and an O&G sheet variant with '12 265 kJ/kWe-hr' and 37,785 kg 'dry weight, enclosed height'. No Centaur 50 Turbomachinery Package Specification was found on allowed hosts (manualsdir has only the Taurus 60 TPS, which does not mention the Centaur 50), so engine mass/size, starter kW, fuel gas pressure, lube volumes, bleed valves and engine change time remain unverified. For a minimum-moving-parts replacement: the existing package expects one single-shaft rotor (11-stage compressor + 3-stage turbine on 3 tilt-pad journal bearings and one active + one inactive thrust bearing), clockwise rotation, epicyclic reduction gear to a 4-pole generator, a turbine-driven lube pump plus AC pre/post and DC backup lube pumps, VIGV and variable stators, and an AC direct-drive starter with VFD.

records.notes: Editions compared (opened PDFs): DS50MD/1109 (2009, C10550210), Spanish DS50MD-ES/1109 (C10574551) and compressor-set DS50CS-ES/1109 (C10574558) - all give 4570 kW (6130 hp), 12 030 kJ/kW-hr, 67 760 kg/hr, 515 C (960 F), 11-stage compressor, GP 2-stage 15,000 rpm max, PT 1-stage 16,500 rpm max, driver skid 6.0 x 2.5 x 2.7 m, 16 330 kg. Differences: the compressor-set sheet prints PR 10.5:1 and airflow 18.5 kg/s versus PR 10.3:1 and 18.4 kg/s in the MD sheet; PR 10.3 kept (MD sheet is the document for this variant). MD sheet prints 'LHV = 5 MJ/nm3 (940 Btu/scf)' - typo for 35 MJ/Nm3. No newer English MD/CS edition (like the 2016 DS40MD/0416 that exists for the Centaur 40) was found: scene7 IDs C10550140-C10550290 and C10574530-C10574575 were probed; within these ranges only the 2009 editions exist for the Centaur 50 MD/CS. BIL/512 (2012, C10550168) repeats 4570 kW / 6130 hp / 29.9 % / 6.0 x 2.5 x 2.7 m / 16 330 kg. The 2011 O&G brochure (C10550151) lists 'APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS (unenclosed)' 6.2 x 2.5 x 2.7 m and 14 970 kg for the Centaur 50 mechanical drive - not used (data sheet preferred for dimensions). Dimensions/weight are driver package only, dry, unenclosed height (DS50CS-ES/1109 footnote '*Sólo equipo de impulsión de la turbomaquinaria'). eff_pct is published ('Engine efficiency: 29.9%'); 3600/12030 = 29.93 confirms. exh_flow_kg_s = published 67 760 kg/hr / 3600. The current solarturbines.com MD page returned HTTP 403 (Akamai) on two attempts 30 s apart and was not opened; per search-index text only (not used as source) it shows 4570 kW / 6130 hp, 12,030 kJ/kW-hr, 67,760 kg/hr, 515 C - same as the 2009 sheet. Nominal PT speed and speed range are not published in the data sheets (rating stated at 'Optimum power turbine speed'); they would need the Centaur 50 Turbomachinery Package Specification (not reachable on allowed hosts). Engine mass/size, starter kW, fuel gas pressure, lube volumes, bleed valves, bearing count and engine-removal method/time for the MD package are not published in the opened documents.
